summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Ivo Werner, born 19 August 1960, a former professional tennis player from Czechoslovakia. He competed for Czechoslovakia and later for West Germany, and is now a tennis coach. He immigrated to West Germany in 1982 and obtained citizenship two years later.
one_line: Ivo Werner is a former Czechoslovak-born professional tennis player who represented West Germany and now works as a tennis coach.
key_facts: Ivo Werner was born on 19 August 1960.
Ivo Werner is a former professional tennis player.
Ivo Werner was originally from Czechoslovakia.
Ivo Werner competed for his native country, Czechoslovakia.
Ivo Werner also competed for West Germany.
Ivo Werner is now a tennis coach.
Ivo Werner immigrated to West Germany in 1982.
Ivo Werner received West German citizenship two years after immigrating, in 1984.
